plan.label: Plan
plan.jev_criteria: Planning and architecture work: decide structure, decompose tasks, weigh trade-offs across files and modules.

issue-triage.label: Issue Triage
issue-triage.jev_criteria: Triage work: read an issue, decide what it is, how urgent it is, where it belongs and what happens next.

review.label: Review
review.jev_criteria: Review work: read diffs and pull requests, judge correctness and risks, decide what must change before merge.

ui-design.label: UI Design
ui-design.jev_criteria: UI design work: decide components, layout and visual structure, design-system and styling choices.

ui-testing.label: UI Testing
ui-testing.jev_criteria: Frontend testing work: reason about user flows and E2E scenarios with Playwright or Cypress, decide what to assert.

api-testing.label: API Testing
api-testing.description: API testing, integration tests, OpenAPI, Postman
api-testing.jev_criteria: API testing work: reason about endpoints, contracts and integration cases with OpenAPI or Postman.

docs.label: Docs
docs.jev_criteria: Documentation work: explain, summarize or document behavior in READMEs, changelogs and docstrings.

debug.label: Debug
debug.description: Debugging, reproductions, crash and exception triage
debug.jev_criteria: Debugging work: diagnose crashes, exceptions and reproductions from traces and symptoms to root cause.

refactor.label: Refactor
refactor.jev_criteria: Refactoring work: restructure and clean up code across modules while preserving behavior.

security.label: Security
security.jev_criteria: Security work: spot vulnerabilities, judge exploitability and the hardening needed.

code.label: Code
code.jev_criteria: Implementation work: write features, functions and endpoints from requirements to working code.

mechanical-engineer.label: Mechanical Engineer
mechanical-engineer.description: Mechanical engineering, calculations, CAD, thermodynamics, materials
mechanical-engineer.jev_criteria: Mechanical engineering work: calculations, CAD, thermodynamics and material decisions.

web-search.label: Web Search
web-search.description: Ricerche approfondite sul web, sintesi multi-fonte
web-search.jev_criteria: Research work: gather, compare and synthesize answers from multiple web sources.

generic.label: Generic
generic.description: General Q&A, explanations, analysis, everything else
generic.jev_criteria: General work: explanations, analysis and Q&A not covered by other categories.

small-model.label: Small Model
small-model.description: Lightweight utility tasks: commit messages, session titles/renames, summaries
small-model.jev_criteria: Trivial mechanical work: commit messages, session titles and renames, short summaries with no design judgement.
